## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The three-juan table of contents (*mùlù* 目錄) to the 30-juan *Jiànzhōng jìngguó xùdēng lù* 建中靖國續燈錄 ([KR6q0007](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0007)), the third of the Sòng Chán lamp records. Separately transmitted — and separately catalogued in the Xuzangjing (X78 n. 1555, distinct from n. 1556 which is the main text) — the *mùlù* is essentially a finding-aid for the 1,712 figures enumerated in the parent work.

**Abstract**

Presented together with the main work to Sòng [徽宗](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BE%BD%E5%AE%97) Huīzōng in the first year of the *Jiànzhōng jìngguó* 建中靖國 reign period (1101). The existence of a separately-transmitted *mùlù* is not unique to this lamp record (cf. the juan-level tables of contents at the head of most Chán lamp records), but the 建中靖國 *mùlù* was transmitted as an independent three-juan text through the Japanese monastic editions that became the basis of the Xuzangjing, and is therefore catalogued separately in modern Chinese Buddhist bibliographies.
